text_block_list.text:
One day, I was handed a flyer for a
'Trainer Appreciation Festival.'
It said the Umamusume would be holding a
live concert for their Trainers.
choice_data_list:
(Ah, looks like they have new outfits
too.)

(Ah, looks like they have new outfits
too.)

text_block_list.text:
Looking at it, I pictured my trainee, <chrname>,
wearing the outfit. If she were to wear
it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what kind of venue would be best for
the live show...?
Where would my gratitude really get
through to Trainer best...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This stage is a classic, and all the
equipment is ready, but...
It's a wiiil bit lacking in fresh appeal,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
However, the best time to act is when
you're troubled!
Let's search every nook and cranny for
anywhere we could hold a concert! Let's
gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—You've improved your skills once again,
Phalaeno.
Unwavering focus and dignified archery.
Magnificent as always.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"............ Truly, what immense power.
To keep your aim true with such arrow
speed is quite an impressive feat."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're just as dynamic as ever,
Brian.
Though when you were little, there were
times you couldn't fully control your
strength.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even during the New Year's calligraphy,
your brush moved so fast you splattered
ink everywhere, didn't you?
I remember wiping down your blackened face
countless times.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I did advise taking a look at an example,
since it only happens once a year.
However... if I recall, Phalaeno stopped
me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it might be good to let her write
whatever comes to mind.
I quite like those rough, powerful
brushstrokes myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you really remember the
smallest details.
...Feels like I've got two older sisters
now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't here be great! It's spacious and
just perfect!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"......And so, we ended up touring all
around the academy...
I'm so sorry for interrupting you during
your lesson, Phalaeno-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no, I don't mind at all. Still, a
live venue, is it?
We could scout together, but... are you
not being a little hasty?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, calming the mind is essential for
deep thought.
For instance... Hmm. Spe, do you have a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
――――Hah! ...Ah, off mark again.
As expected, shooting accurately like
Phalaeno-san is tough.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, worry not. Your posture is quite
solid.
Neck, back, the spread of your legs. Try
to focus on aligning all of them along
your center.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And above all, the spirit is what truly
matters. Have unwavering confidence that
you can overcome your doubts.
...You can do that, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Special Week. An Umamusume who boldly
challenged adversity and triumphed.
Show me your heart... once more.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno-san...
—Yes, understood! I'll... give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Right in the center, dead center,
Phalaeno-san!
Somehow, my mind just went totally calm
and clear... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"............ Truly impressive, Special
Week.
That is our Supreme Commander for you."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was so cool!
It's the fruit of Spe and Phalaeno's
destinies overlapping!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the academy really is wonderful!
Destinies intertwine and guide one
another!
Eff and the others, Ruler and her group,
everyone... â!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"......Right, the concert too! A place
where countless destinies intertwine...
And that means the destinies of everyone
in the academy...! Ohh, ohhh~~!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've got it, I've got it!
There's only one place for the live venue!
Come on, over here--!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The concert venue is right here!
Let's put on the show in this entrance!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Here...? Are you sure a familiar place
like this is alright?
Trainers pass through here quite often,
too...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is precisely why!
Because it is a familiar place... destiny
will gather right here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Pushing each other to new heights with
classmates, cooperating with friends...
This entrance is where every facet of an
Umamusume's academy life intersects.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's the place where all our destinies
overlap into one!
Not just the Umamusume, but the Trainers,
too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why we should convey our
gratitude to our Trainers from here!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is part of our destiny too, after
all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-san is part of our destiny...
...Fufu, that somehow sounds just like
you, Epi-san."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Still, isn't this fine?
A familiar spot will probably get
everyone's vibes way higher, too, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I agree too.
...I feel like there are feelings I can
only convey because we're here.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right, that settles it!
Dance, costumes, venue... All preparations
are officially complete!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The venue is all set!
Showtime's practically here... Let's do
our best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone, go call your Trainers!
Starting this very second, the 'Trainer
Appreciation Festival' begins!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Convey your gratitude with your own two
hands!
—Destiny itself says so!!"

The day of the "Trainer Appreciation
Festival." Waiting in the trainer's office
before the live show,
just as the instructions stated...

text_block_list.name: Home Screen Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-san!
*Plays home screen Umamusume system
voice*"

I heard her voice.
A familiar voice I had heard countless
times, day in and day out.

Hearing my name, I turned around to find
<chrname> standing there in green trousers.
choice_data_list:
Could it be... are you going to the
concert too, by any chance?
